title: Pro classic `form` widget — 3 fields (text/email required + textarea) + email action, mirroring SUPPLEMENT §A.3
_comment: WP-R03 VALID Pro-forms fixture (SUPPLEMENT §A.3 worked example). Classic V3 `form` widget: 3 form_fields each with a unique repeater `_id` AND a unique sanitized `custom_id`; `required` is the STRING "true" (the SWITCHER return_value 'true' — the #1 forms gotcha, NOT a bool); `placeholder` only on placeholder-eligible types; `rows` on the textarea. submit_actions:['email'] with the email controls flat (email_to/email_subject/email_content [all-fields]/email_reply_to=field custom_id). VERIFIED valid:true via Validator::dry_run on Elementor Pro 4.1.0. requires.pro:true (skipped, not failed, on free-only installs). prefilter.verdict:defer (§4 — the TS pre-filter structurally accepts a classic widget; field/action semantics are deferred to PHP).
